nodes.description: Oracle.token0: address of the first token of the tracked Uniswap V2 pair.
Oracle.token1: address of the second token of the tracked Uniswap V2 pair.
Oracle.pair: IUniswapV2Pair instance from which cumulative prices and reserves are read.
Oracle.blockTimestampLast: last uint32 block timestamp stored by the oracle.
Oracle.price0CumulativeLast: last stored cumulative price for token0.
Oracle.price1CumulativeLast: last stored cumulative price for token1.
Oracle.price0Average: UQ112x112 average price of token0 over the epoch.
Oracle.price1Average: UQ112x112 average price of token1 over the epoch.
Epoch.period: length in seconds of an epoch.
Epoch.startTime: timestamp at which the epoch schedule may start.
Epoch.lastEpochTime: timestamp of the last epoch point.
Epoch.epoch: monotonically increasing epoch counter.
Operator._operator: privileged address allowed to call operator-restricted functions.
Ownable._owner: contract owner address controlling governance functions.
Oracle constructor: stores pair, token0/token1, cumulative prices and reserves, and initializes Epoch.
Oracle.update: epoch-gated recomputation of the average prices from Uniswap cumulative values.
Oracle.consult: view returning amount out based on the last stored average price.
Oracle.twap: computes a spot TWAP directly from live cumulative prices and the elapsed time.
Epoch.checkEpoch modifier: restricts pre-epoch calls to the operator and advances the epoch counter in a loop.
Epoch.getCurrentEpoch: view returning the current epoch counter.
Epoch.nextEpochPoint: returns lastEpochTime + period using checked SafeMath addition.
Epoch.setPeriod: operator-only update of the epoch period, bounded between 1 and 48 hours.
Epoch.setEpoch: operator-only manual override of the epoch counter.
Operator.transferOperator: owner-only entry point delegating to _transferOperator.
Operator._transferOperator: internal state-changing update of the privileged operator address.
Operator.isOperator: view comparing the caller with the stored operator.
Ownable.transferOwnership: onlyOwner function that reassigns contract ownership.
Ownable.onlyOwner modifier: reverts unless the caller is the stored owner.
UniswapV2OracleLibrary.currentCumulativePrices: reads live cumulative prices and applies counterfactual accumulation.
UniswapV2OracleLibrary.currentBlockTimestamp: block.timestamp truncated to uint32.
FixedPoint.mul: multiplies a UQ112x112 by a uint with overflow check.
FixedPoint.decode144: truncates a UQ144x112 value back to uint144.
FixedPoint.fraction: builds a UQ112x112 ratio of reserves, reverting on zero denominator.
SafeMath.add: overflow-checked addition used for epoch time math.
SafeMath.sub: underflow-checked subtraction used to derive lastEpochTime.
SafeMath.mul: overflow-checked multiplication library helper.
msg.sender: external caller address, attacker-controllable.
block.timestamp: miner-influenced timestamp used for epoch gating and price math.
External call to pair.getReserves() returning reserve0, reserve1 and blockTimestampLast.
External calls to pair.price0CumulativeLast()/price1CumulativeLast() for live cumulative prices.
Unchecked uint32 subtraction blockTimestamp - blockTimestampLast where overflow is intended.
Division of cumulative price deltas by timeElapsed, only protected by an early zero check.
State write of price0Average/price1Average derived from manipulable external cumulative price data.
Timestamp-dependent access gate: pre-epoch calls of checkEpoch are permitted only for the operator.
Role check comparing msg.sender to _owner/_operator backing onlyOwner and onlyOperator.
Privileged state write of the operator address inside _transferOperator.
Unchecked subtraction and division on live cumulative prices in twap, with no zero-elapsed guard.
Constructor parameter _pair: Uniswap V2 pair used by the oracle.
Constructor parameter _period: epoch duration passed into the Epoch constructor.
Constructor parameter _startTime: epoch schedule start timestamp.
Constructor parameter _startEpoch: initial epoch counter (0 for Oracle).
Parameter _period of Epoch.setPeriod, bounded between 1 and 48 hours.
Parameter _epoch of Epoch.setEpoch, manually overriding the epoch counter.
Parameter newOperator_ of Operator._transferOperator.
Parameter newOwner of Ownable.transferOwnership.
Parameter _token of Oracle.consult selecting which average price to use.
Parameter _amountIn of Oracle.consult, the input amount to price.
Returned amountOut of Oracle.consult.
Parameter _token of Oracle.twap selecting which cumulative price to use.
Parameter _amountIn of Oracle.twap.
Returned _amountOut of Oracle.twap.
Local price0Cumulative returned by currentCumulativePrices inside update.
Local price1Cumulative returned by currentCumulativePrices inside update.
Local blockTimestamp returned by currentCumulativePrices inside update.
Local timeElapsed computed as blockTimestamp - blockTimestampLast in update.
Parameter pair of currentCumulativePrices.
Local price0Cumulative of currentCumulativePrices, including counterfactual accumulation.
Local price1Cumulative of currentCumulativePrices, including counterfactual accumulation.
Local blockTimestamp of currentCumulativePrices, from currentBlockTimestamp().
Local reserve0 read from pair.getReserves().
Local reserve1 read from pair.getReserves().
Local blockTimestampLast returned by pair.getReserves().
Local counterfactual timeElapsed in currentCumulativePrices (overflow intended).
Local _nextEpochPoint cached in the checkEpoch modifier.

edges.reason: _pair argument supplied to the Oracle constructor and stored as the tracked pair.
_period is forwarded by the Oracle constructor into the Epoch constructor.
_startTime is forwarded by the Oracle constructor into the Epoch constructor.
_startEpoch (0) is forwarded by the Oracle constructor into the Epoch constructor.
Constructor assigns the pair state variable.
Stored pair address is used to perform the external getReserves() call.
Stored pair address is used for the external cumulative price reads.
Constructor calls pair.price0CumulativeLast()/price1CumulativeLast().
External cumulative price0 result initializes price0CumulativeLast.
External cumulative price1 result initializes price1CumulativeLast.
Constructor calls pair.getReserves() to obtain reserves and timestamp.
blockTimestampLast returned by getReserves() initializes the oracle timestamp.
Constructor caches pair.token0() into token0.
Constructor caches pair.token1() into token1.
Epoch constructor writes period from the _period argument.
Epoch constructor writes startTime from the _startTime argument.
Epoch constructor writes the initial epoch counter.
lastEpochTime = startTime.sub(period), relying on checked SafeMath subtraction.
nextEpochPoint reads the epoch period.
nextEpochPoint reads lastEpochTime.
lastEpochTime.add(period) uses overflow-checked SafeMath addition to derive the next epoch point.
checkEpoch compares now against nextEpochPoint().
checkEpoch caches nextEpochPoint() into the local _nextEpochPoint.
Cached _nextEpochPoint drives the epoch advance loop inside checkEpoch.
Oracle.update is gated by the checkEpoch modifier: before the epoch point only the operator may proceed.
checkEpoch implements a timestamp-based access gate keyed on now vs nextEpochPoint.
block.timestamp (now) determines whether the caller must be the operator, making the guard timestamp dependent.
msg.sender is compared with operator() for pre-epoch calls.
update execution path depends on the timestamp gate enforced by checkEpoch.
update calls currentCumulativePrices(address(pair)) to fetch live cumulative prices.
currentCumulativePrices returns price0Cumulative into the update local.
currentCumulativePrices returns price1Cumulative into the update local.
currentCumulativePrices returns blockTimestamp into the update local.
Local price0Cumulative is used in the average price computation inside update.
Local price1Cumulative is used in the average price computation inside update.
Local blockTimestamp is used for timeElapsed and stored into blockTimestampLast.
update computes timeElapsed = blockTimestamp - blockTimestampLast where 32-bit overflow is explicitly intended.
blockTimestamp is the left operand of the wrapping subtraction.
blockTimestampLast is the right operand of the wrapping subtraction.
Wrapping subtraction result is stored in the local timeElapsed.
update divides cumulative price deltas by timeElapsed, guarded only by an early equal-zero return.
timeElapsed is the divisor in the average price computation.
Division result is packed into the new average price values that are written to storage.
Wrapping timeElapsed feeds the average price state write.
Attacker-influenceable cumulative price0 feeds the average price write.
Attacker-influenceable cumulative price1 feeds the average price write.
Update writes the new price0Average state variable.
Update writes the new price1Average state variable.
Update refreshes price0CumulativeLast with the latest cumulative value.
Update refreshes price1CumulativeLast with the latest cumulative value.
Update stores the latest blockTimestamp into blockTimestampLast.
_token parameter selects the average price branch in consult.
_amountIn parameter is the input amount to be priced by consult.
consult reads price0Average for token0 quotes.
consult reads price1Average for token1 quotes.
consult multiplies the stored average price by _amountIn via FixedPoint.mul.
price0Average is an operand of the multiplication.
price1Average is an operand of the multiplication.
FixedPoint.mul result is returned into consult for decoding.
decode144 truncates the UQ144x112 multiplication result to uint144.
Computed value is assigned to the returned amountOut.
_token parameter selects the cumulative price branch in twap.
_amountIn parameter is the input amount priced by twap.
twap calls currentCumulativePrices to obtain live cumulative prices.
twap computes blockTimestamp - blockTimestampLast and divides by it with no elapsed-time zero check.
blockTimestampLast participates in the twap time delta.
twap multiplies the derived average ratio by _amountIn using FixedPoint.mul.
twap stores the multiplication output before decoding.
decode144 truncates the twap result to uint144.
Time-derived ratio feeds the returned twap amount.
Locally computed _amountOut is returned by twap.
msg.sender is compared against the stored owner/operator inside the role-check helper.
Stored operator address is the expected caller for onlyOperator.
Stored owner address is the expected caller for onlyOwner.
transferOperator is reachable only after the onlyOwner role check succeeds.
transferOwnership is reachable only after the onlyOwner role check succeeds.
setPeriod is restricted to the operator via onlyOperator.
setEpoch is restricted to the operator via onlyOperator.
newOperator_ parameter is validated and written by _transferOperator.
_transferOperator writes the new privileged operator address.
The privileged operator state write is the sensitive operation performed by _transferOperator.
transferOperator delegates to the internal _transferOperator.
isOperator compares the caller with the stored operator address.
newOwner parameter is validated and assigned by transferOwnership.
transferOwnership reassigns the _owner state variable.
_period parameter is range-checked then written by setPeriod.
_epoch parameter overwrites the epoch counter in setEpoch.
setPeriod updates the period state variable.
setEpoch updates the epoch state variable.
pair parameter selects the Uniswap pair queried by currentCumulativePrices.
currentBlockTimestamp() provides the uint32 block timestamp used by currentCumulativePrices.
block.timestamp is truncated into uint32 for the oracle timestamp.
The counterfactual cumulative price computation depends on the miner-influenceable block timestamp.
Oracle.update results (and its gate) depend on block.timestamp, a timestamp-dependency risk.
currentCumulativePrices reads the pair cumulative last values through external calls.
currentCumulativePrices calls pair.getReserves() for the counterfactual accumulation.
reserve0 is returned by the getReserves() external call.
reserve1 is returned by the getReserves() external call.
blockTimestampLast is returned by the getReserves() external call.
price0CumulativeLast external value initializes the local price0Cumulative.
price1CumulativeLast external value initializes the local price1Cumulative.
Counterfactual timeElapsed = blockTimestamp - blockTimestampLast where uint32 overflow is intended.
Local uint32 blockTimestamp is the left operand of the wrapping subtraction.
price0Cumulative is incremented by elapsed-time-weighted reserve ratio, accumulating manipulable reserve data.
price1Cumulative is incremented by elapsed-time-weighted reserve ratio.
FixedPoint.fraction builds the counterfactual price ratio added to price0Cumulative.
Computed price0Cumulative is returned by currentCumulativePrices.
Computed price1Cumulative is returned by currentCumulativePrices.
Computed blockTimestamp is returned by currentCumulativePrices.
FixedPoint.mul follows the same overflow-checked multiplication pattern as SafeMath.mul for price arithmetic.
